subject: Kelso Bio — converting renewal to Azure Marketplace billing
messages:
From: Alex Reed <alex.reed@kelso.bio>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Eve Turner <eve.turner@kelso.bio>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kelso renewal — marketplace billing option

Hi Dylan,

Hope you’re well — quick one as our renewal for Redwood inference (annual) is coming up in late October. Procurement at Kelso is pushing for all renewals to go through the Azure Marketplace this year to consolidate invoicing and use our internal spend controls.

We’ve been happy with the product and want to move forward, but they need to confirm a simple marketplace purchase path (seat counts, SKU mapping, invoice cadence). Are you able to convert our existing contract so Kelso can pay through the Azure Marketplace for the next term?

CC’ing our procurement lead Eve Turner. Once we confirm the mapping and any amendment, procurement will route a PO and sign. Happy to hop on a 30m call if helpful.

Thanks,
Alex Reed
Head of Platform
Kelso Bio

Attachment: kelso_current_contract.pdf (stub)
From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reed <alex.reed@kelso.bio>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kelso renewal — marketplace billing option

Alex — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the program change. We can absolutely support a move to Azure Marketplace for the renewal; we just need to align on a few operational points so the cutover is smooth.

Can you confirm the following from procurement:
- Expected invoice cadence (monthly/annual/quarterly)
- Total committed seats or spend to list on the marketplace SKU (we can map to our existing enterprise SKU)
- Any required billing address or billing contact for the marketplace registration

Internal next steps on our side: I’m looping Marissa (sales ops) to draft an amendment and SKU mapping, Connor for the provisioning/entitlement handoff, and Lauren from legal to review any marketplace EULA implications.

If procurement prefers, we can do a 30-minute call next week to walk through the DocuSign amendment and timeline — available Tue/Thu mornings PT.

Thanks — I’ll draft the initial amendment once we have the above details.

— Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Reed <alex.reed@kelso.bio>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eve Turner <eve.turner@kelso.bio>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kelso renewal — marketplace billing option

Thanks Dylan — answers from procurement below:
- Invoice cadence: annual preferred (single PO) but they can accommodate monthly if necessary for cashflow.
- Committed spend: same as current contracted ARR (we'll attach PO once amendment is final).
- Billing contact: billing@kelso.bio (cc’d as Kelso Bio Billing).

Procurement also asked for: a short doc that shows how our current entitlement (seat-based tier) maps to the Azure marketplace SKUs and any SKU IDs so their cloud-finance team can validate. Also would appreciate a note on how refunds/credits are handled if we need to downscale mid-term.

We can do a call Tuesday 9/8 at 10am PT if that works for your team. I’ve also pasted Eve here to handle PO logistics.

— Alex

On Thu, Sep 3, 2026 at 11:04 AM dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Alex — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the program change. We can absolutely support a move to Azure Marketplace for the renewal; we just need to align on a few operational points so the cutover is smooth.

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Kelso — draft amendment & SKU mapping (internal)

Team — I’ve drafted an amendment to enable Azure Marketplace billing and mapped our enterprise SKU to the marketplace listing. Draft attached: kelso_amendment_draft.pdf. Key notes:
- Marketplace SKU will be mapped to current enterprise seat tier (SKU: RWI-ENTERPRISE-01 -> AZ-MKT-RWI-01)
- Invoice cadence set to annual (per customer request) and billing contact will be billing@kelso.bio
- Refunds/credits: standard Redwood credit policy applies; we’ll include a 30-day pro-rata credit clause for early termination/downscale.

Grace — can you confirm whether finance is OK with annual marketplace invoicing (recognition impact) and whether we need a billing memo for their AR team. Lauren — please triage any legal redlines; I kept changes minimal to avoid procurement friction.

Attachment: kelso_amendment_draft.pdf
From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reed <alex.reed@kelso.bio>, Eve Turner <eve.turner@kelso.bio>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kelso renewal — marketplace billing option

Alex/Eve — thanks for the fast replies. Plan and next steps: 
1) We’ll finalize the amendment (Marissa) and send via DocuSign for signature by Friday 9/10.
2) Marissa will include SKU mapping and the marketplace SKU IDs in the DocuSign packet for your cloud-finance validation.
3) Kelso to return a signed PO to billing@redwood.ai (we’ll accept the PO as the order confirmation once amendment is fully executed).
4) Connor will coordinate entitlement provisioning once Kelso is onboarded to marketplace purchases (typically 2–3 business days after activation).

Alex — confirming call Tuesday 9/8 10am PT is on our side; invite coming from my calendar. I’ve attached the internal draft and the marketplace guide to send to procurement.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we’ll aim for zero service interruption during the cutover.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: kelso_amendment_draft.pdf, azure_marketplace_guide.html
